application_credentials.description: Plant Ranger comes with a built-in Home Assistant client, so you normally do not need to enter anything here. To use your own OAuth application instead, create one in the [Plant Ranger Developer Dashboard]({developer_dashboard_url}) with the redirect URI `{redirect_url}` and enter its Client ID below. The Client Secret can be left empty.

abort.no_team: The authorized token does not grant access to a Plant Ranger team.
abort.wrong_account: Wrong account: Please authenticate with the account this entry was set up with.

reauth_confirm.description: The Plant Ranger integration needs to re-authenticate your account.
reauth_confirm.title: [%key:common::config_flow::title::reauth%]

auth_failed.message: Authentication with Plant Ranger failed, please re-authenticate.

data_description.enable_demo: Creates a fake plant with changing readings so the integration can be tried without hardware.
